title: DHFWS Rampurhat Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 36 Pharmacist, Staff Nurse and Medical Officer Posts
description: District Health & Family Welfare Samiti Rampurhat (DH&FWS Rampurhat) has issued an official notification for the recruitment of 36 Pharmacist, Staff Nurse, and Medical Officer positions. Candidates who have passed BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, B.Sc Nursing, GNM, and D. Pharm can use this chance and apply for the DHFWS Rampurhat Notification 2026 .
